dogecoin.text:
Updating my $DOGE chart. #dogecoin seems to be forming a bull wedge, .68 all the way to .74 seems likely. Even if we fall out of the wedge, one of the charted supports (white) could catch us

That one big wickdown was a big 3 minute selloff quickly bought up. #DogecoinToTheMoon https://t.co/giPJm8YAw3

Weekly recap! 4/5 calls hit nicely
$LINK 39.2 > 48.5 (and beyond!)
$ETH 3377 > 3724 (and beyond!)
$XLM didn't retrace as expected, but hit .65 as anticipated!
$DOGE .575 > .68 > .74
$BTC didn't play out bearish, but that's good, right?

Have a blessed Sunday guys, take care

Do what you will with this information. #dogecoin can still be dumped HARD and we had a nice show of how much that can affect the price already. I wouldn't touch it for anything but scalps with a 10 foot pole.

Invest wisely. Don't let the whales play you. Not financial advice.

A week ago I posted how 46.3% of all $DOGE is owned by 13 wallets, trading at .74. Now, 45.7% of all $DOGE is owned by 11 wallets. That means 2 whales dumped the market, and despite the fact that there was a small shift in ownings (46.3 > 45.7), price dropped to .50
